name: Brawl Cars - CWCL 2021 Game Jam Submission
author: FluffballGames
description:
Dizziness Warning: Don't play this game if you get dizzy easily. If you get dizzy take a break from the game.                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                               
 This game is a combination of racing and fighting and based off the 1984 game:  Demolition Derby by Midway! Ram into the backs of each others cars or shove them off/into the different obstacles. If your car gets hit a lot it will explode and you lose. Music by ElectroFuzz. https://electrofuzz.bandcamp.com/music
